clozeEasy.translation: 爸爸每週倒垃圾一次，七天一次。

clozeEasy.sentence: Our ___ piano lesson is every Friday afternoon.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Our weekly piano lesson is every Friday afternoon.
clozeEasy.translation: 我們每週的鋼琴課在每個星期五下午。

clozeMedium.sentence: This ___ magazine appears every Friday, fifty-two issues a year.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: This weekly magazine appears every Friday, fifty-two issues a year.
clozeMedium.translation: 這本週刊每週五出刊，一年五十二期。

clozeMedium.sentence: The team practices ___, three afternoons each week.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The team practices weekly, three afternoons each week.
clozeMedium.translation: 球隊每週練習三個下午。

clozeHard.sentence: A ___ pass lasts seven days, longer than a one-day ticket but shorter than a thirty-day one.
clozeHard.fullSentence: A weekly pass lasts seven days, longer than a one-day ticket but shorter than a thirty-day one.
clozeHard.translation: 週票效期七天，比一日票長、比三十日票短。
clozeHard.clue: 效期七天的票

entries.example: It often snows here in winter.

cloze.sentence: People wear heavy coats and drink hot soup in ___, the coldest season.
cloze.fullSentence: People wear heavy coats and drink hot soup in winter, the coldest season.
cloze.translation: 冬天人們穿厚外套、喝熱湯，這是最冷的季節。

clozeEasy.sentence: We build snowmen and go skiing in ___.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: We build snowmen and go skiing in winter.
clozeEasy.translation: 我們在冬天堆雪人、去滑雪。

clozeEasy.sentence: The days are short and the nights are long in ___.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: The days are short and the nights are long in winter.
clozeEasy.translation: 冬天白天短、夜晚長。

clozeMedium.sentence: ___ is the time for hot pot, right between the falling leaves and the new blossoms.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: winter is the time for hot pot, right between the falling leaves and the new blossoms.
clozeMedium.translation: 冬天是吃火鍋的季節，介於落葉與新花之間。
clozeMedium.clue: 落葉與新花之間、吃火鍋

clozeMedium.sentence: Many birds fly to warm places before ___ arrives with its frost.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Many birds fly to warm places before winter arrives with its frost.
clozeMedium.translation: 許多鳥在帶著霜雪的冬天來臨前飛往溫暖的地方。

clozeHard.sentence: The coldest time between the falling leaves and the new blossoms is ___, when ice covers the pond.
clozeHard.fullSentence: The coldest time between the falling leaves and the new blossoms is winter, when ice covers the pond.
clozeHard.translation: 落葉與新花之間最冷的時候是冬天，池塘結了冰。
clozeHard.clue: 落葉與開花之間、池塘結冰

entries.example: There are twelve months in a year.

cloze.sentence: Earth goes around the sun once every ___, passing through all four seasons.
cloze.fullSentence: Earth goes around the sun once every year, passing through all four seasons.
cloze.translation: 地球每年繞太陽一圈，經歷四季。
cloze.clue: 地球繞太陽一圈的時間

clozeEasy.sentence: How many months are there in a ___? Twelve.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: How many months are there in a year? Twelve.
clozeEasy.translation: 一年有幾個月？十二個。

clozeEasy.sentence: My cousin is one ___ old; he was born last January.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: My cousin is one year old; he was born last January.
clozeEasy.translation: 我表弟一歲，他是去年一月出生的。

clozeMedium.sentence: A ___ takes three hundred sixty-five days, the time Earth needs to circle the sun.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: A year takes three hundred sixty-five days, the time Earth needs to circle the sun.
clozeMedium.translation: 一年需要三百六十五天，這是地球繞太陽一圈的時間。
clozeMedium.clue: 地球繞太陽一圈的時間

clozeMedium.sentence: Students move up one grade every school ___.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Students move up one grade every school year.
clozeMedium.translation: 學生每學年升一個年級。
clozeMedium.clue: 從九月到隔年六月的學習週期

clozeHard.sentence: Twelve of these make one ___, and each one ends with December's fireworks.
clozeHard.fullSentence: Twelve of these make one year, and each one ends with December's fireworks.
clozeHard.translation: 十二個月構成一年，每年以十二月的煙火收尾。
clozeHard.clue: 由十二個月組成

entries.example: The school holds a sports day yearly.

cloze.sentence: The town holds its lantern festival ___, once every twelve months.
cloze.fullSentence: The town holds its lantern festival yearly, once every twelve months.
cloze.translation: 小鎮每年舉辦燈籠節，每十二個月一次。

clozeEasy.sentence: We visit our grandparents ___, one long visit every year.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: We visit our grandparents yearly, one long visit every year.
clozeEasy.translation: 我們每年探望祖父母一次，每次都待很久。

clozeEasy.sentence: Snakes shed their skin ___, about one time per year.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Snakes shed their skin yearly, about one time per year.
clozeEasy.translation: 蛇每年蛻皮約一次。

clozeMedium.sentence: A ___ physical checkup happens once every calendar year.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: A yearly physical checkup happens once every calendar year.
clozeMedium.translation: 年度健檢每個曆年做一次。

clozeMedium.sentence: Unlike ___ meetings, which happen twelve times a year, this one happens once.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Unlike yearly meetings, which happen twelve times a year, this one happens once.
clozeMedium.translation: 每月會議一年開十二次，而這個年度會議只開一次。

clozeHard.sentence: A ___ pass covers all three hundred sixty-five days, longer than any shorter-term ticket.
clozeHard.fullSentence: A yearly pass covers all three hundred sixty-five days, longer than any shorter-term ticket.
clozeHard.translation: 年票涵蓋整年三百六十五天，比任何短期票都長。
clozeHard.clue: 涵蓋整年三百六十五天

entries.example: It rained yesterday.

cloze.sentence: ___ it was sunny, but the rain came this morning.
cloze.fullSentence: yesterday it was sunny, but the rain came this morning.
cloze.translation: 昨天是晴天，但今天早上就下雨了。

clozeEasy.fullSentence: yesterday I finished the book, one full day before now.
clozeEasy.translation: 我昨天看完那本書，比現在早了整整一天。

clozeEasy.translation: 昨天是星期一，所以今天一定是星期二。

clozeMedium.sentence: We baked cookies ___, and only a few are left now.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: We baked cookies yesterday, and only a few are left now.
clozeMedium.translation: 我們前一天烤了餅乾，現在只剩幾塊。

clozeMedium.sentence: The museum opened a new exhibit ___, one day before now.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The museum opened a new exhibit yesterday, one day before now.
clozeMedium.translation: 博物館昨天，也就是一天前，開放了新展覽。

clozeHard.sentence: ___ has gone by, and no one can change what happened then.
clozeHard.fullSentence: yesterday has gone by, and no one can change what happened then.
clozeHard.translation: 昨天已經過去，誰也無法改變當時發生的事。
clozeHard.clue: 已經過去、無法改變的那天
